description: [Acquire · 5 credits] Search LinkedIn people. Filter by company, title, location, or free-text keywords. Costs 5 credits per page of 25 (map_constellation's built-in lead search is billed at a bundled 1 credit instead, a deliberate discount). Each person comes back with current title, company, company id, start date and location. To list the people at one company, pass its LinkedIn company URL or numeric id as `company` and walk `page` while `truncated` is true. Results are saved to `people` with their current position, so get_outreach_path can route to them (pass a result's `person_id` as `target_person_id`).

company.description: Current company. Pass a LinkedIn company URL (https://www.linkedin.com/company/acme) or a numeric LinkedIn company ID (e.g. '1441', the `id` linkedin_company_info and linkedin_company_search return) for an exact match; comma-separate several. A plain name is matched loosely and can return people from other companies, so prefer the URL or ID.

page.description: Results page, 25 people per page (default 1). 5 credits per page not already cached.

refresh.description: Bypass the cache and re-run the search live (costs 5 credits). Default false: a previously-fetched result is returned free, with how long ago it was retrieved.

title.description: Current title filter (e.g. 'Director'). Comma-separate several (e.g. 'SDR,Account Executive').

name: linkedin_people_search
title: LinkedIn People Search
